relationships.subject: HIF-1α
relationships.evidence_quote: SMIR promoted HIF-1α expression and inhibited AQP1 expression in DRG.

relationships.subject: 2ME2
relationships.evidence_quote: HIF-1α levels were significantly decreased after injection (P < 0.01).

relationships.subject: 2ME2
relationships.evidence_quote: HIF-1α inhibitor reversed the decrease in AQP1 expression and increase in NF200 expression, barrier permeability and hyperalgesia induced by SMIR on the 3rd day post-surgery.

key_findings: SMIR increased DRG HIF-1α, decreased AQP1 and increased blood-nerve barrier permeability in rats.
HIF-1α inhibitor 2ME2 reversed AQP1 loss, barrier hyperpermeability, NF200 increase and hyperalgesia.
